name: Contralateral dead bug
definition: Lie supine with arms reaching upward and hips and knees bent, keeping the feet off the floor. Reach one arm overhead while extending the opposite leg, return them, and alternate the pairing.

catalogue_anchor.notes: Original broad muscle labels retained separately; not silently promoted to accepted anatomy.

value.start: Lie supine with arms reaching upward and hips and knees bent, keeping the feet off the floor.
value.movement: Reach one arm overhead while extending the opposite leg, return them, and alternate the pairing.
value.finish: Return to the same bent-leg, arms-up start between pairings.
value.range_of_motion: Reach only to the selected repeatable limb endpoints while retaining the chosen trunk/pelvis position.
